about: The one rule book for what may never appear in Greg's posts (Greg 2026-10-31, 'Start the Now list'). Read by the reel caption gate (src/publish-folder.mjs), the slide gate (src/slide-preflight.mjs, Greg's brand only), `reel policy` (the content engine checks every caption with it before scheduling) and anything else that writes as Greg. Client brands keep their own never-say lists in their brand files. Change a rule here, not in code.

rules.source: Greg 2026-10-17 'dont talk about ghost PnL'; brand guide v10

it asks for a retired keyword (GHOST, SCALE, LEAKS or FREEDOM)

rules.source: Greg 2026-10-29: the hiring portal never appears in content
brand guide v10 proof rules: no income or dollar outcome claims
Greg's voice: no dashes in copy written as him (slides have their own copy-dash check)

standing: Real photos and footage of Greg only; AI images only as labeled B-roll, never a recognisable person or a face.
No invented numbers, quotes, testimonials or client names.
AI is never the hook, the title or the call to action.
One ask per post at most. Comment-keyword asks only once something answers those comments automatically.
Cadence, slots and caption endings: ~/automation/ig-content/RUNBOOK.md (step 3 WEEKLY PLAN, step 6).
